articles.title: Highmark Accused of Steering Specialty Drug Prescriptions to Affiliated Pharmacy
articles.summary: Jefferson's LVHN pharmacy alleges that health insurer Highmark is redirecting specialty-drug prescriptions away from its provider-based pharmacy and toward an entity owned by Highmark's parent company. This practice highlights ongoing channel conflicts in specialty pharmacy distribution that directly impact provider networks and self-funded plan cost management.
articles.source_line: Source: Medical Daily; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 01:14:36 GMT

articles.title: CVS Restructuring Sparks Debate on Prescription Drug Cost Transparency
articles.summary: CVS is considering splitting parts of its massive pharmacy empire, raising questions about whether structural changes will actually lower prescription costs for consumers and employers. As scrutiny on integrated PBM and retail pharmacy models intensifies, self-funded plan sponsors are closely watching how such corporate realignments might impact drug pricing and transparency.
articles.source_line: Source: Florida Daily; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 20:43:02 GMT

articles.title: New PBM Disclosure Rules Expose Opaque Compensation for Employers
articles.summary: Mercer examines a new pharmacy benefit manager disclosure rule designed to increase financial transparency around hidden revenue streams and compensation. This regulatory shift provides self-funded employers with greater visibility into PBM pricing structures, enabling them to negotiate more cost-effective plan designs.

articles.title: Proto360 Health Integrates Genetic Testing Into Employer Obesity Programs
articles.summary: Proto360 Health has integrated Phenomix Sciences' MyPhenome genetic test into its employer-sponsored obesity care programs to help personalize weight-loss treatments. This development targets self-funded employers seeking innovative ways to manage and optimize the high costs associated with GLP-1 and obesity drug coverage. The integration highlights a growing trend toward precision medicine in employer benefit designs to curb specialty drug spending.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:01:00 GMT

articles.title: No Surprises Act IDR Claims Add $8.4B to Employer Plan Costs
articles.summary: A new study reveals that independent dispute resolution (IDR) claims under the No Surprises Act cost self-funded employer plans an additional $8.4 billion last year. This surge in unexpected out-of-network arbitration costs significantly impacts overall health plan expenditures and benefits strategy for employers.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 18:45:20 GMT

articles.title: Deloitte Cuts Weight-Loss GLP-1 Coverage and Raises Employee Health Costs
articles.summary: Major employer Deloitte is eliminating insurance coverage for GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss while simultaneously increasing health insurance costs for its US workforce. This move highlights the ongoing struggle large self-funded employers face regarding the unsustainable financial burden of obesity medications. The decision signals a potential tipping point where more enterprise employers may pull back on discretionary specialty drug coverage to curb rising benefit costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Business Insider; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:46:00 GMT

articles.title: GLP-1 Users Stretch Doses and Supply Due to High Costs
articles.summary: Rising out-of-pocket costs are forcing patients on GLP-1 medications to skip doses or ration their supply. This behavioral shift highlights ongoing affordability challenges that directly impact employer-sponsored health plan utilization patterns and adherence metrics.

articles.title: Federal Agencies Launch Electronic Prior Authorization Readiness Testing for Industry
articles.summary: Federal regulators are inviting healthcare industry stakeholders to test their readiness for electronic prior authorization (ePA) systems. This initiative directly impacts PBMs and employer-sponsored health plans as the industry moves toward streamlining prior authorization workflows and reducing administrative burdens for specialty and traditional medications.
articles.source_line: Source: Modern Healthcare; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 23:06:50 GMT

articles.title: CVS Restructures Amid Strong Earnings and Congressional Scrutiny
articles.summary: CVS Health reported a 27% earnings beat and announced a corporate split, drawing immediate skepticism from lawmakers like Senator Elizabeth Warren regarding PBM transparency and pricing practices. This structural shift highlights ongoing regulatory and political pressure facing major PBMs, which directly impacts self-funded employer health plans navigating market reform.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Thu, 12 Nov 2026 03:40:00 GMT

articles.title: Evaluating the Strategic Implications of CVS Health's Proposed 2028 Corporate Split
articles.summary: CVS Health is weighing a potential corporate split by 2028, raising significant questions about execution risks and long-term value creation. For self-funded employers and PBM competitors, a structural separation of CVS Caremark from its retail and insurance operations could profoundly reshape market dynamics, pricing models, and contract negotiations. Plan sponsors must monitor how such a breakup might alter PBM transparency, service delivery, and market competition.
